Crest stands as a global leader in comprehensive license plate production. Our machines span worldwide, from Germany to India and Poland to Mexico, in this specialized niche. We offer more than traditional protective and reflective films. The inclusion of watermarks and modern security features like RFID is growing in our global solutions.

With more than 40 years of experience, Crest Dutch Machinery develops industrial laminators for a wide range of materials, applications and processes. Our solutions are designed and engineered by our in-house team.
We pride ourselves on delivering outstanding quality for clients across the world.
Industrial converting with standard machines all the way to high tech processes with the latest composite materials, printed electronics and nano technology.
Taking care of our customers and uptime solutions is most important. From installation to training and maintenance, we deliver operational excellence throughout all our solutions.
Doing your business with us, is doing business with a solid team of professionals that understand your needs and offer the best solutions.
Whether you’re looking for a standalone machine, a solution with in- and output equipment or an integrated application into your production line, we are your dedicated partner.

We are experts in the development and production of complete laminating solutions. Our mission is to be a reliable, open and honest partner. We strive for sustainable relationships with strategic suppliers and other stakeholders. Our processes are in accordance with ISO 9001.

Crest Dutch Machinery designs and builds custom laminating, cutting and winding machines and complete converting lines in Raalte, the Netherlands. From an adapted standard machine to a production line built from scratch, engineered in-house from concept to accepted machine.

Every product that wins its market started as a production problem nobody had solved yet. That is where we come in, with a complete in-house engineering team that designs every machine around one thing only: your process.

Sometimes the answer is a proven Crest machine, adapted with the right peripherals. Sometimes it is a fully custom production line that has never been built before. Every machine in our portfolio can be customized, and if none of them fits, we start from a blank sheet. Roll-to-roll, roll-to-sheet, sheet-to-sheet or sheet-to-roll, in foam, plastics, glass, metals, rubber and beyond.
Whatever your tolerance window, material stack-up or cycle-time target, we engineer the most direct path from concept to consistent production.
Custom does not mean uncertain. Our process is designed to remove risk at every step:
: we analyse your product, materials and cycle-time targets, and tell you honestly what is feasible.
: you accept the machine on proven results, not promises.
: commissioning, operator training, spare parts and service agreements.
The best proof of our custom capabilities is what leaves our workshop. A
production line for license plates
. Different industries, different materials, one common denominator: a production challenge no standard machine could answer.
Where required, we deliver cleanroom-ready configurations, 24/7 inline setups with automated feeding, in-process cross-cutting and stacking, and smart changeovers that keep downtime to a minimum.
RECENT CUSTOM PROJECTS

A food-grade line that laminates PE, metallised PET and PE in a single pass at up to 2,200 mm working width. Infrared pre-heating and heated rollers activate the hotmelt, water-chilled rollers stabilise the web, and a dual-position turret winder changes rolls automatically, so lamination never stops.
An inline laminator integrated directly into an extrusion line. A multi-cassette unwind system changes film rolls without stopping, for 24/7 bubble-free protection of rigid sheets.
Battery, smart glass, solar, hydrogen: four worlds where Crest custom machines run in production today.
Cell stack lamination with cleanroom-ready precision.
Delicate functional films, laminated without compromise.
Do you build complete production lines?
We do. From a single machine to a fully integrated inline production line with feeding, laminating, cutting, stacking and winding, engineered and tested as one system.
That depends entirely on scope. After the application intake you receive a clear proposal with budget and lead time.
Which materials can you process?
Foam, plastics, glass, metals, rubber, technical textiles and combinations of these, including delicate or coated webs that demand precise web-tension control.

Lead time depends on the scope of the machine. For many projects around three months from order is realistic; complex inline lines take longer. You receive a firm lead time together with the proposal.
Yes. Every custom machine is tested in our Raalte workshop with your own materials before it ships. Acceptance is based on proven results.

The production and lamination of battery cells for electric vehicles (EVs) stand as key drivers in the progression of the electric mobility sector. Amidst the rising prominence of electric cars and growing demand for renewable energy sources, the enhancement and development of EV batteries have ascended to the forefront of the modern industry.

With our industrial laminators we enable our customers in the converting industry to combine multiple layers of material into new materials and products. We offer the right machinery that is capable of slitting and cutting.

Word onze nieuwe Finance Manager en houd grip op de financiële koers van Crest! In deze parttime MT-functie (20-28 uur) ben jij verantwoordelijk voor betrouwbare cijfers, projectbewaking en de koppeling tussen Ridder IQ en Exact Online. Jij zorgt dat financiën en techniek naadloos op elkaar aansluiten.

Stap in de boeiende wereld van machinebouw als onze nieuwe Allround Machinebouwer! In deze essentiële rol ben jij de persoon die onze machines en componenten tot leven brengt binnen onze productiefaciliteit.

Ben je een professional met passie, een no-nonsense mentaliteit en ervaring in de machinebouw, maar vind je geen positie die perfect bij je past? Geen zorgen! Wij staan altijd open voor talent zoals jij. Stuur ons een open sollicitatie.

We zijn continu op zoek naar bevlogen professionals die ons team kunnen versterken. Jouw unieke vaardigheden en ervaring kunnen precies zijn wat we nodig hebben. Bij ons vind je een omgeving waar innovatie, samenwerking en groei centraal staan.
